settings.agents_subtitle: Configure Home Assistant conversation agents, external AI providers, and agent-to-agent protocols.
settings.ha_agent_desc: Select which Home Assistant conversation agent powers the "Ask Assistant" chat (✦ button). This connects to HA's built-in Assist pipeline or any configured LLM agent (Google AI, OpenAI, Ollama).
settings.ha_agent_help: Agents are registered in HA → Settings → Voice Assistants. Add Google Generative AI, OpenAI, or Ollama integrations to see more options here.
settings.ext_ai_desc: Configure which external AI service the "Ask AI" button sends tasks to (separate from HA Assist). Generates a pre-filled prompt with task context for analysis.
settings.agent_protocols_desc: Expose Meitheal tools to AI agents via A2A, WebMCP, and MCP protocols. Enable agent-to-agent collaboration, browser agent tools, and tool discovery.
settings.a2a_desc: Serve an Agent Card at /.well-known/agent.json so other AI agents can discover and delegate tasks to Meitheal.
settings.webmcp_desc: Register Meitheal tools with your browser's AI assistant (Chrome EPP). Allows browser agents to create tasks, search, and navigate boards.
settings.mcp_discovery_desc: Serve tool definitions at /.well-known/mcp.json for MCP-compatible clients.
settings.bot_handoff_subtitle: Control how AI agents propose changes to your tasks. Bots use a claim → propose → accept/reject workflow.
settings.bot_allow_proposals_desc: When enabled, AI agents (HA Assist, MCP, n8n) can claim tasks and submit proposals for your review before changes are applied.
settings.bot_auto_accept_desc: Automatically accept proposals that only change status (e.g. pending → active) or add labels. Title, description, and priority changes always require manual review.
settings.bot_lock_timeout_desc: How long a bot can hold a task lock before it auto-releases. Shorter = less risk of stuck tasks. Default: 5 minutes.
settings.rules_presets_subtitle: Choose a starting configuration — customise below
settings.rules_assignment_subtitle: Choose which strategic lenses apply to each task type
settings.rules_ai_scope_subtitle: Control what AI agents are allowed to do for each type
settings.rules_ai_instructions_placeholder: Optional instructions for AI agents working on {type}s...
settings.rules_fw_config_subtitle: Edit weights, descriptions, and formulas for each framework
settings.rules_fw_ref_subtitle: Learn about each strategic evaluation framework
settings.rules_fw_ref_rice_desc: Reach × Impact × Confidence ÷ Effort. Prioritization framework from Intercom for scoring tasks by audience reach, impact, confidence, and effort.
settings.rules_fw_ref_drice_desc: Extended RICE that factors in dependency weight — how many other tasks are blocked by this one.
settings.rules_fw_ref_ddd_desc: Domain-Driven Design. Evaluates tasks through bounded context alignment, ubiquitous language, and strategic/tactical pattern fit.
settings.rules_fw_ref_heart_desc: Happiness, Engagement, Adoption, Retention, Task success. Google's UX metrics framework for holistic UX impact scoring.
settings.rules_fw_ref_kcs_desc: Knowledge-Centered Service. Evaluates documentation tasks: is knowledge captured at creation, reusable, and continuously improved?
settings.rules_fw_ref_wsjf_desc: Weighted Shortest Job First. Calculates Cost of Delay ÷ Job Duration to sequence work for maximum economic benefit.
settings.rules_fw_ref_moscow_desc: Must / Should / Could / Won't prioritization. Classifies requirements into four categories for scope and stakeholder management.
settings.rules_fw_ref_ice_desc: Impact × Confidence × Ease. Lightweight scoring system for rapid experiment prioritization, each dimension scored 1-10.

presets.strategic_desc: RICE + DDD + KCS — full scoring for epics and stories
presets.ux_desc: HEART + KCS — user experience metrics for stories
presets.agile_desc: WSJF for epics, ICE for stories — SAFe-inspired
presets.balanced_desc: MoSCoW for epics, RICE for stories — strategic + tactical
presets.simple_desc: No frameworks — minimal guardrails for quick tasks

settings.danger_archive_subtitle: Remove completed tasks you no longer need
settings.danger_archive_callout_desc: Complete = work is done, task stays visible. Archived = complete task hidden from daily views. This control permanently deletes both, based on when they were last updated. Active and in-progress tasks are never touched.
settings.danger_zone_callout_desc: These actions are intentionally separated from everyday settings because they remove data or revert behavior globally. Double-check exports before using them.
settings.callout_data_title: Use this for backup and recovery
settings.callout_data_desc: Export tasks or settings before major changes, and keep a local copy if you want fast recovery outside Home Assistant.
settings.app_readiness_subtitle: Installability, offline health, browser handoff, and Home Assistant companion reopening.
settings.app_readiness_callout_desc: Install from a standalone browser tab when you want the full PWA prompt. Use Companion and x-callback links when you need to reopen the same section inside the Home Assistant app, Siri Shortcuts, or automations.
settings.pwa_about_p1: Meitheal (IPA: /ˈmɛhəl/) — from Irish: a cooperative work party where neighbours come together to help with farming, harvesting, or building. The tradition reflects a core principle: work shared is work halved.
settings.pwa_about_p2: A Home Assistant-native, Astro-first task and life management engine — built for people who think in systems.
settings.pwa_open_browser_title: Open in a standalone browser tab (required for install prompt)
settings.pwa_uninstall_how:
How to uninstall:
Chrome/Edge: Open the installed app → ⋮ menu → "Uninstall Meitheal"
Safari: Long-press the icon on your home screen → Remove
Firefox: Not applicable (does not support PWA install)
settings.pwa_uninstall_safe: Your data is safe — uninstalling the PWA only removes the shortcut and cached shell.
settings.pwa_why_unavailable_desc: PWA features (offline support, install prompt) require HTTPS. Options: Nabu Casa (automatic), DuckDNS + Let's Encrypt (free), or a reverse proxy. The app works fully without HTTPS.
settings.pwa_troubleshoot_desc: If the app is behaving unexpectedly, these self-help actions may resolve it.
settings.pwa_companion_title: Open this section in Home Assistant Companion
settings.pwa_companion_desc: Use the documented homeassistant://navigate URL handler to jump straight back into this section, or copy an x-callback URL for iOS Shortcuts and automation flows.
settings.pwa_companion_hint: Use these companion links in the mobile app, Siri Shortcuts, or HA automation payloads without leaving ingress-safe Settings routes.
settings.accent_hint: Changes apply immediately across all pages.
settings.help_started_p1: Meitheal is a local-first task and life management engine built for Home Assistant. Your data lives on your device. No cloud required.

settings.help_started_li5: All data is exportable as JSON, CSV, or raw SQLite
settings.help_arch_li3: Home Assistant WebSocket API for calendar and todo sync
settings.help_arch_li5: Domain-Driven Design with bounded contexts per feature
settings.callout_personal_desc: Adjust language, theme, accent color, timezone, and date defaults here. Changes apply across Meitheal immediately.
settings.callout_shortcuts_desc: These shortcuts work best when you want to stay in flow instead of opening extra navigation or modals.

settings.calendar_sync_desc: Sync tasks with due dates to your Home Assistant or CalDAV calendar. Tasks appear as events with priority color coding.
settings.caldav_hint: For direct CalDAV sync (Nextcloud, Radicale, etc). Leave blank to use HA calendar only.
settings.grocy_desc: Connect to Grocy for household inventory and chore management. Meitheal can import Grocy tasks and expose its own tasks back.
settings.n8n_desc: Trigger automation workflows when tasks are created, updated, or completed. Create complex pipelines that react to task events.
settings.webhook_desc: Generic outgoing webhooks for any service. Each event sends a JSON payload with the full task object and event type.
settings.webhook_secret_hint: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign webhook payloads. Verify with the X-Webhook-Signature header.
settings.ai_desc: Configure which AI service the "Ask AI" button sends tasks to. Generates a pre-filled prompt with task context for analysis.
settings.language_subtitle: Interface language — content stays in its original language
settings.data_subtitle: Meitheal is local-first. You own your data.
settings.export_hint: Export your tasks to JSON/CSV, or download the entire raw SQLite database file for full local-first data sovereignty.
settings.config_hint: Backup or restore your tokens, shortcuts, UI layouts, and active integrations. Restoring will trigger a page reload.
